faq_heading: New Horizons houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in New Horizons. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

New Horizons, Coquitlam: 5 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 2 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 40% on only 5 listed, too few to read as a market type. By listings that is number 13 of 23 Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in New Horizons was little changed, 5 in June and 5 in October (+0.0%), and 8 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 1.3% of Coquitlam’s 378 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in New Horizons?
New Horizons also had 24 condos and townhomes listed and 8 sold in October, against 5 houses listed. The New Horizons condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: New Horizons home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

23 houses sold in New Horizons with a median price of $1,200,000 (the middle half sold between $1,111,500 and $1,256,444), taking a median of 12 days to sell at 97.4% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $601 per square foot, a median year built of 1980 and a median lot of 4,101 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in New Horizons?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 5 houses listed in New Horizons. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is New Horizons a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in New Horizons had a sales ratio of 40% on only 5 listed, too few to read as a market type. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in New Horizons from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 8 houses sold in New Horizons over those 5 months, out of 273 in all of Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in New Horizons?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in New Horizons sell for?
faq.a: 23 houses sold in New Horizons between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,200,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in New Horizons?
faq.a: The median was 12 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.4% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
